overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair did not reasonably anticipate discussing Town Meeting motions on the May 1 notice, which were only raised by a clerk's same-day drafts.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board discussed Town Meeting warrant motions at its May 1 meeting without listing that topic on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because this was not foreseen by the chair at least 48 hours prior to the May 1 meeting, any discussion of the motions would be permissible under the Open Meeting Law.

source.publisher_filename: DETERMINATION - 6 22 2017 - OML 2017-101 - ROWLEY BOARD OF WATER COMMISSIONERS.pdf
